subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM reply threading be exposed as a new `dmThreadMode` account setting, folded into the existing `replyToMode` contract, or deferred behind broader thread-routing work?
rationale: This is an additive public config/API choice that reopens a previously fixed Google Chat DM delivery failure mode, so code review cannot safely decide the permanent product surface by itself.

options.title: Decide the config API first
options.body: Choose the public option shape before merge, then require the branch to align types, generated metadata, docs, tests, and live proof with that choice.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` as a separate knob
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally keep the DM-only setting, but the branch must add the missing config contract surfaces and redacted real Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Defer to broader thread-routing work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the existing Google Chat `replyToMode` or thread-session PRs to settle the canonical threading model first.

recommendation.title: Decide the config API first
recommendation.body: Choose the public option shape before merge, then require the branch to align types, generated metadata, docs, tests, and live proof with that choice.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided maintainer verification for the prior DM-thread suppression fix and have adjacent Google Chat thread-reply history.
